scheme_name: Sanction of Motorized Three Wheeler to Orthopedically Challenged
other_conditions: Loco‑motor or orthopedic disability of at least 80%
Valid driving licence as per Motor Vehicle Act
Mental retardation or illness disqualifies the applicant
Student must be pursuing postgraduate or professional courses, or self‑employed for at least 3 years
Upper limbs must be strong enough to drive the vehicle
benefits_summary: Free distribution of a motorized three‑wheeler.
